verdict.rationale: Bridge, part of this product's documented stack, has a sandbox for testing an integration without moving real money (stripe-crypto-docs-42), and its orchestration covers on-ramps, off-ramps and crypto-to-crypto flows (stripe-crypto-docs-40). Stripe also documents general sandboxes with working API keys (stripe-crypto-docs-45). However, nothing shows that these sandboxes cover Stripe's stablecoin payments, stablecoin payouts or fiat-crypto conversions specifically, and no test values or deterministic behavior are documented. Missing for 10: evidence that sandbox or testnet mode covers stablecoin payments, payouts and conversions; documented deterministic test values (test wallets, amounts, outcomes); hands-on corroboration.
